      226 +    // Read-only accessors: plain field reads, no rules.                                               
      227 +                                                                                                       
      228 +    /// Panes of group `g`, in tab order.                                                              
      229 +    pub fn group(&self, g: Group) -> &[PaneId] {                                                       
      230 +        &self.groups[g.index()]                                                                        
      231 +    }                                                                                                  
      232 +                                                                                                       
      233 +    /// Selected tab of group `g`.                                                                     
      234 +    pub fn selected(&self, g: Group) -> Option<&PaneId> {                                              
      235 +        self.selected[g.index()].as_ref()                                                              
      236 +    }                                                                                                  
      237 +                                                                                                       
      238 +    /// The group that has keyboard focus.                                                             
      239 +    pub fn focus(&self) -> Group {                                                                     
      240 +        self.focus                                                                                     
      241 +    }                                                                                                  
      242 +                                                                                                       
      243 +    /// `(h_ratio, v_ratio)` in percent.                                                               
      244 +    pub fn ratios(&self) -> (u8, u8) {                                                                 
      245 +        (self.h_ratio, self.v_ratio)                                                                   
      246 +    }                                                                                                  
      247 +                                                                                                       
      248 +    /// The zoomed pane, if any.                                                                       
      249 +    pub fn zoom(&self) -> Option<&PaneId> {                                                            
      250 +        self.zoom.as_ref()                                                                             
      251 +    }                                                                                                  
      252 +                                                                                                       
      253 +    /// Recorded type of pane `id`.                                                                    
      254 +    pub fn pane_type(&self, id: &str) -> Option<PaneType> {                                            
      255 +        self.types.get(id).copied()                                                                    
      256 +    }                                                                                                  
      257 +}
